bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH WEDNESDAY EVENING... Combined seas 10 to 12 ft this morning, increasing to 13 to 16 ft late Tuesday. Bar conditions rough becoming severe late. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 445 AM Tuesday, 445 PM Tuesday, and 530 AM Wednesday. The afternoon ebb Tuesday will be strong.
